# IKE Version Management Extension

> Maven 4 build extension that implements the IKE typed-marker
> family for version-property naming:
> ${groupId__GA__artifactId__VERSION}. Reads __ALIAS
> properties from the inherited file-model and injects the
> declared short-name indirections, fails fast on undeclared
> canonical references, and detects ${G.A} typos with a
> corrective hint. Accepts the pre-#525 U+00B7 form during
> the transition. See IKE-Network/ike-issues#470, #472,
> #525, #526.

## Documentation

- [IKE Version Management Extension](https://ike.network/ike-version-management-extension/index.html.md)
